question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Meta)

calls.reasoning: Meta reports Q3 2026 ~Oct 28. It disclosed a ~$10B Q3 legal accrual for the multistate youth settlement (not in July guidance), ~$3.3-3.9/share, so GAAP diluted EPS (the only EPS Meta reports) should be ~$2.8-3.6, far below 5.345. Ex-charge consensus ~$6.25-6.77 and Meta's habitual 2-10% beats imply adjusted ~6.6-7.3. Criteria are blank; the only resolved question in this Metaculus series (Nvidia, June 2026) resolved on GAAP (2.46 vs non-GAAP 2.22), and Investing.com scored Meta Q2 on GAAP, so I put ~70% on GAAP resolution (declared below-range mass capped at 0.5); the range centred near consensus is the counter-signal. Market check: web tools failed this run; prior runs found no Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi contract matching Meta Q3 EPS. Web access failed this run (API errors), so evidence is from local journal traces of earlier research — thin, flagged.
